Experience as an acute care Cardiovascular Nurse Practitioner

As our Cath Lab Nurse Practitioner, you will provide direct care to patients undergoing cardiac interventional procedures. You will help streamline and expedite patient flow by evaluating normal and abnormal findings, initiating treatments, and coordinating admissions and discharges in accordance with approved Standardized Procedures.

Every day you will enter pre- and post-procedure orders, facilitate and triage transfer patients being evaluated for procedures, and collaborate with cardiologists and cardiac interventionalists on new consults and ongoing treatment plans. You will follow patients through discharge, manage unexpected post-procedure complications, provide patient education and counseling, manage incisions and dressings, and complete consults and documentation in collaboration with the cardiologist. You will also discharge patients from the Cardiac Interventional Unit and Cardiac Support Unit, including medication reconciliation, and document medication changes or complications in a brief progress note.

To be successful in this role, you must provide care in accordance with the Standardized Procedures approved by the Mercy General Hospital Committees for Credentials, Interdisciplinary Practice, and Cardiology. Program coverage is six days a week, Monday through Saturday.
